description: Lists Futuur's event categories so you can filter get_markets by category id or slug. A category belongs to a tree (for example Politics > USA > 2028 Elections); filtering by a top-level category includes everything below it. view="all" (default) is the paginated list of categories that have open events, with their full path, open event count and volume; view="root" lists just the top-level categories; view="featured" is the 10 highest-volume categories. Use get_category_details for one category's subcategories.

currency_mode.description: Count open events and rank volume for "play_money" or "real_money". Omit for play money counts.

limit.description: Categories per page, 1 to 200. Default 100. Only with view "all".

offset.description: Number of categories to skip, for paging. Default 0. Only with view "all".

search.description: Case-insensitive text to match in category titles. Only with view "all" or "featured".

view.description: "all" (default): paginated list of every category with open events, A to Z. "root": top-level categories only. "featured": top 10 by volume.

name: get_categories
title: List categories
